selection_rationale: User selected checkpoint 34000 after nominal/noisy standing, load/release recovery and seeded training-parameter comparisons. Best basic/noisy wrist result among reviewed fresh-run candidates; not exhaustive hardware validation.

protocol.selection: All 16 basic trials must pass survival and recovery; rank mean noisy unforced wrist RMS, then action-rate RMS. Compare to baseline.
protocol.caveat: Finite native CPU MuJoCo tests; no hardware validation or guarantee for stronger/different loads.

protocol.sensor_rng: numpy; same bounds, not browser bitwise trajectory
protocol.parameter_draw: all groups enabled; startup ranges, one draw per trial
protocol.contacts: training for randomized trials; frictional-body 0.5/feet 0.6 for noise ablation
protocol.loads: downward: 30 N each palm, 1 s ramp / 2 s hold / 1 s release, starts 5 s
protocol.recovery_gate: same standing-checkpoint limits; relative to 3–5 s baseline

domain_randomization.metadata_note: contacts.foot_sliding_friction copied from already-recorded randomized_values; rollout results unchanged
